delta.text: key = lines[i++]; while (!key.endsWith(":") ...)` — `String.endsWith()` is safe on an empty string (just returns false). This refactoring commit replaced
it with a `StringBuffer` and `sb.charAt(sb.length() - 1)`, which throws `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` when `sb` is empty (length 0), i.e., when `lines[i]` was

an empty string. This is exactly the bug the fix commit addresses by guarding with `sb.length() == 0 ||`.
